create_accuracy_metric: create an Accuracy metric instance to compute top-k classification accuracy from predictions and labels
create_loss_metric: create a Loss metric instance to track and aggregate loss values during training
create_metric_list: create a MetricList to aggregate multiple EvalMetric instances like Accuracy and Loss together
update_metric_with_preds: update an EvalMetric with prediction tensors, label tensors, and loss tensors to accumulate results
get_metric_name_value: get the name-value pairs from an EvalMetric with an optional prefix for logging output
